trading.liquidityCustodyPolicy: The actual seeded v4 position and any LP fees remain permanently in VeylLiquidityVault. Unused seed inputs and the unallocated token remainder return to the creator; exact launch amounts remain pending approval.

zkapi.daemonHostPlan: Installed prelaunch shared-VPS pilot: one running job and daemon pair, fifty saved profiles, two CPU cores and 4 GiB aggregate memory cap with no swap. The authenticated gateway is connected; funded execution and mainnet writes remain disabled. Move to a separate server before growing production workloads.
zkapi.reconciliationPolicy: Reserve each live model catalog cap plus a bounded 1000 microUSD rounding allowance before dispatch. Reconcile exact ETH charges only from authenticated durable native receipts bound to the saved call, session, journal and original quote; release unused budget once. Unknown or legacy calls stay held and inference is never automatically replayed. Real funded acceptance was deliberately not run.
